name: Green Bay Plastics
old_description: – Custom manufacturer of plastic bottles, jars, and industrial components and products.
about:
Green Bay Plastics, Inc. was incorporated in 1957 in Green Bay, Wisconsin, initially as part of Mosinee Paper Corporation. In 1989, J. Kevin Hogan and his wife JoAnn led a buy-out, returning the company to family ownership. Today it remains family-owned and operated, with Michael Hogan as president and general manager, Patrick Hogan as vice president, and Kathleen Hogan-Lesatz as controller and secretary-treasurer.

The company specializes in custom blow molding, producing plastic bottles, jars, canisters, containers, and wheels. They design and build their own manufacturing machinery, auxiliary equipment, and tooling in-house. Production runs range from a few thousand units to mass-production volumes. Additional services include labeling, painting, and special packaging.

Green Bay Plastics serves a range of industries including food and beverage, lubricants, personal care, dietary supplements, medical and healthcare, household products, sporting goods, toy components, and general industrial applications. Customers include wholesale distributors and brand owners seeking custom packaging and components.

The company emphasizes self-sufficiency through proprietary equipment design and in-house tooling, which it says allows tighter control over lead times and part complexity. The family ownership structure is cited as a driver of long-term customer relationships and consistent quality.
